sources: trip_data/ridb_campsites.json (RIDB campsite catalog for facility 232319, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: recreation.gov 2026 and 2027: standard non-electric site $26, electric $30 ($4 hookup fee), walk-to tent site $24, group site $80. An extra vehicle is $8/night. The FS page still shows lower figures (single $22, electric $26, walk-in $20, group $60).

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232319/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-10-10 and 2027-05-21 to 2027-10-09, and the first-come weeks before them: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 26, STANDARD ELECTRIC 30, WALK TO 24, GROUP 80) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232319 (fee description 'A $4.00 per night electrical hookup fee applies to Electric sites'; notice 'Extra vehicle will be charged an $8 per night fee') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/colwell-lake-campground ('Single campsite $22 Walk-in campsite $20 Single campsite with electricity $26 ... Group Campsite, up to 24 persons $60'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: The discount applies to the base rate only (not the electric fee).

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/colwell-lake-campground ('Federal Recreation Passes (Golden/America the Beautiful) are accepted.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232319 ('Discount only applies to base rate.'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: The two reservable electric sites (002, 004) are 15-amp; two unreservable catalog sites list 30-amp.

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232319 (reservable STANDARD ELECTRIC 002 and 004: Electricity Hookup 15; unreservable 003 and 005: 30; no water or sewer attribute on any site) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/colwell-lake-campground ('Vault Toilets, electricity, water hydrants, a dump station ... are available'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: The catalog lists 31 family sites that take RVs (18 to 40 ft, 13 to 60 ft; 5 pull-throughs), two walk-to tent-only sites on the lakeshore and a 24-person group site; 17 family sites plus the group site are reservable. Some sites overlook the water. One RV with tow vehicle per site; most sites take one extra vehicle on the spur.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232319 (site types, reservable flag, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232319 ('many individual family sites, as well as a group site that can hold 24 people and two tent-only sites along the lake shore'; 'some campsites overlook the water'; notice 'One RV with tow vehicle per single site ... Most sites can accommodate 1 extra vehicle'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Water hydrants through the campground. Boat ramp and launching pier near the entrance with trailer turn-around, accessible fishing pier, swimming beach (no lifeguard).

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/colwell-lake-campground ('Potable water is available at this site.' 'Vault Toilets, electricity, water hydrants, a dump station, lakeside path and skid pier are available.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232319 ('vault toilets and drinking water located throughout the facility'; 'a boat ramp and launching pier near the campground entrance ... adequate space for parking and a trailer turn-around'; 'an accessible fishing pier'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 17 family sites and the group site are reservable; the other family sites are not reservable in the catalog, and the season's first week (about May 15-21) is a first-come season on recreation.gov. Run by a concessionaire (recreation.gov refers to 'the campground concessionaire', unnamed). A reserved site is held until noon the day after arrival.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232319 (rule maxConsecutiveStay 14; notices 'Reserved Sites will be held until checkout time (NOON) the day following your arrival date', 'will be declined by the campground concessionaire') + /rates ('First-come, First-served Season' 2026-05-15 to 05-21, 2027-05-14 to 05-20) + RIDB catalog (reservable flag per site), read 2026-10-25

values.note: FS season of use May 13 - October 8; recreation.gov's 2026 seasons run May 15 - October 10.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/colwell-lake-campground ('Seasons of Use May 13 - October 8'; 'This campground is currently closed for the season', last updated October 8, 2026) + recreation.gov /rates (2026 first-come season from 05-15, peak season to 10-10), read 2026-10-25

note: Hiawatha NF campground on the eastern shore of 145-acre Colwell Lake, 25 mi north of Manistique via M-94 and FR 2246, in mixed hardwood and conifer forest. Sandy swimming beach with a picnic area, and a 2-mile hiking and snowshoe trail. Bass, pike, crappie, perch and bluegill. --Claude
summary: rec.gov API + rates + RIDB catalog + FS page: electric 15 confirmed (reservable sites 15 A; no water/sewer), 31 RV sites to 60 ft with pull-throughs (new), vault toilets + drinking water confirmed, dump station (new), $26-30 confirmed (2026 and 2027; FS page shows older $22/$26), passes accepted (new), reservable on recreation.gov with some first-come sites (fcfs some_sites, 14-night max, url new), season May 13 - Oct 8 (new). Concessionaire-run (unnamed). No forest alert or order touches the campground or M-94/FR 2246. Phone differs (flag). Note trimmed of field restatements.
